items.name: Retries & Backoff
items.tag: AWS SDKs, Step Functions, Glue, Lambda
items.text: Retry transient throttling/timeouts with growing waits + jitter. Built into SDKs, SFN Retry, Glue MaxRetries, Lambda async/ESM.

items.name: Idempotency
items.text: At-least-once delivery is common. Overwrite S3 partitions, MERGE on keys, use DDB conditional writes, or Glue bookmarks/checkpoints.

items.name: SQS Decoupling
items.text: Buffers bursts up to 14 days so sides scale independently. Set visibility timeout > processing time; redrive failed msgs to DLQ.

blocks.caption: Publish once to SNS; fan out to SQS queues (durable copies) or email/Lambda alerts.
blocks.heading: Alerts with SNS

items: SNS is push (no retention) for fan-out/alerts; SQS is pull & durable for buffering work queues.
SQS visibility timeout < processing time causes duplicate processing; set it longer than max runtime.
Cap retries then route to a DLQ or alert — never retry forever; pair every DLQ with a CloudWatch alarm.
FIFO queues give ordering & exactly-once dedup, but lower throughput than Standard — use only if ordering is needed.
